title: Refactor Error Handling
problem_statement: The codebase uses the error suppression operator (@) which can hide errors.
risk_if_unaddressed: Hidden errors can lead to undetected failures and make debugging difficult.
suggested_approach: Refactor the code to remove the use of the @ operator and implement proper error handling.
success_criteria: All instances of @ operator are removed.

provenance.evidence: Usage of @ operator to suppress errors.
